description: Complexity taxonomy and quality gate definitions for the Gemma extraction benchmark.

1.label: minimal-single-actor
1.description: Single named actor, one clear event, unambiguous source type. Establishes baseline model performance.

2.label: multi-actor-dependency
2.description: Two to four named actors where a decision or outcome depends on their interaction. Model must capture all relevant names.

3.label: collective-implicit-actors
3.description: Actor is described by role or group noun only (e.g. 'the ops team', 'the compliance officer'). No personal names present. Model must decide between Unknown and the role label.

4.label: compound-multi-event
4.description: Narrative contains multiple distinct activities or events. Model must scope to a single representative event rather than flattening all into one.

5.label: source-ambiguous
5.description: Narrator's direct participation is unclear. Source type (self-report / observation / third-party) is genuinely ambiguous from the text.

schema_validity_rate.description: Fraction of cases where all required fields pass validator constraints.

actor_non_empty_rate.description: Fraction of cases where actor_names is a non-empty list (validator minimum).

dead_letter_rate.description: Fraction of cases that exhaust all retries and reach DEAD_LETTER state.
